reuse_note: diagnostic reuse of the existing 64 target-slot worlds in their original 8 disjoint blocks; not an independent confirmation
reporting_unit: the 8 blocks; checkpoints, facts and hybrid probes within a block are repeated measurements, not extra replicates

design.selection_rule: first contiguous target acquisition run and first contiguous target challenge run, in native event order; chosen before inspecting any outcome
design.post_bout_probe: COMMON controller: adapt set to the sham fork's post-bout vector in BOTH forks before probing, so only what the bout wrote into fast/slow is measured
design.oracle_note: the B controller is a diagnostic reference, not a deployable mechanism; a deployable controller could not read B, the target label, cohort role or future relevance

readout_relevant_state_difference.note: at rep=0 the readout sees alpha_fast and slow ONLY through their sum

gamma_fast_note: read by expression and differing hugely between arms (L1 ~5e3 in C vs ~1e-74 in B), yet its contribution to the scored margin is <=4e-9. A measured near-inertness of the gamma pathway at the scored quantity, NOT a construction null and NOT evidence about its learning role.
